keifu — Git commit graph visualizer (cleaned)

keifu is a terminal UI tool that visualizes Git commit graphs. It shows a colored commit graph, commit details, and a summary of changed files, and lets you perform basic branch operations.

Screenshot: see docs/win_terminal.png

Features

- Unicode commit graph with per-branch colors
- Commit list with branch labels, date, author, short hash, and message
- Commit detail panel with full message and changed file stats
- Git operations: checkout, create/delete branch, fetch
- Branch search with dropdown UI

Usage

Run inside a Git repository:

  keifu

Configuration

See docs/configuration.md for configuration options (user-level config at ~/.config/keifu/config.toml).

Keybindings (user-facing)

Navigation:
- j / ↓ : Move down
- k / ↑ : Move up
- h / ← : Select left branch
- l / → : Select right branch
- g / Home : Go to top
- G / End : Go to bottom
- q / Esc : Quit

Git operations:
- Enter : Checkout selected branch/commit
- b : Create branch at selected commit
- d : Delete branch (local, non-HEAD)
- f : Fetch from origin

Notes

- Run inside a Git repository.
- Requires a terminal with Unicode and color support and the git command available in PATH.

# 🧬 keifu

[![Crate Status](https://img.shields.io/crates/v/keifu.svg)](https://crates.io/crates/keifu)
[![Built With Ratatui](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built_With-Ratatui-000?logo=ratatui&logoColor=fff&labelColor=000&color=fff)](https://ratatui.rs)

[English README](../README.md)

keifu (系譜, /keːɸɯ/) は、ターミナル上で Git のコミットグラフを可視化する TUI ツールです。カラー付きのグラフ、コミット詳細、変更ファイルの要約を表示し、基本的なブランチ操作も行えます。

![スクリーンショット](win_terminal.png)

## 開発動機

- **読みやすいコミットグラフ** — `git log --graph` は読みづらいので、色分けされた見やすいグラフで表示したい
- **素早いブランチ切り替え** — AI コーディングの普及で、並列にブランチを切って作業することが増えた。ブランチ操作を視覚的かつ高速に
- **シンプルに保つ** — 基本的な Git 操作のみをサポートし、多機能な Git クライアントにはしない
- **狭い画面でも快適** — ターミナル分割や小さいウィンドウでも適切に表示
- **画像プロトコル不要** — Unicode 対応のターミナルであればどこでも動作

## 特長

- ブランチごとに色分けされた Unicode グラフ表示
- ブランチラベル、日付、著者、短いハッシュ、メッセージを表示（ターミナル幅が狭い場合は一部省略）
- コミット詳細パネル（フルメッセージと変更ファイルの統計）
- Git 操作: checkout、ブランチ作成/削除、fetch
- ドロップダウン UI によるブランチ検索

## 動作要件

- Git リポジトリ内で実行してください（カレントディレクトリから自動検出します）
- Unicode の罫線文字とカラー表示に対応したターミナル
- PATH に `git` コマンド（fetch に必要）
- Rust ツールチェーン（ソースからビルドする場合）

## インストール

### crates.io から

```bash
cargo install keifu
```

### mise を使う

```bash
mise use -g github:trasta298/keifu@latest
```

### Homebrew を使う

```bash
brew install trasta298/tap/keifu
```

### ソースから

```bash
git clone https://github.com/trasta298/keifu && cd keifu && cargo install --path .
```

## 使い方

Git リポジトリ内で実行します:

```bash
keifu
```

## 設定

設定オプションについては [configuration_ja.md](configuration_ja.md) を参照してください。

## キーバインド

### ナビゲーション

| キー | 操作 |
| --- | --- |
| `j` / `↓` | 下へ移動 |
| `k` / `↑` | 上へ移動 |
| `]` / `Tab` | ブランチラベルのある次のコミットへジャンプ |
| `[` / `Shift+Tab` | ブランチラベルのある前のコミットへジャンプ |
| `h` / `←` | 左のブランチを選択（同一コミット内） |
| `l` / `→` | 右のブランチを選択（同一コミット内） |
| `Ctrl+d` | ページ下へ移動 |
| `Ctrl+u` | ページ上へ移動 |
| `g` / `Home` | 先頭へ移動 |
| `G` / `End` | 末尾へ移動 |
| `@` | HEAD（現在のブランチ）へジャンプ |

### Git 操作

| キー | 操作 |
| --- | --- |
| `Enter` | 選択中のブランチ/コミットを checkout |
| `b` | 選択中コミットからブランチを作成 |
| `d` | ブランチ削除（ローカル/非 HEAD のみ） |
| `f` | origin から fetch |

### 検索

| キー | 操作 |
| --- | --- |
| `/` | ブランチを検索（インクリメンタル・ファジー検索） |
| `↑` / `Ctrl+k` | 前の検索結果を選択 |
| `↓` / `Ctrl+j` | 次の検索結果を選択 |
| `Enter` | 選択したブランチへジャンプ |
| `Esc` / 空欄で `Backspace` | 検索をキャンセル |

### その他

| キー | 操作 |
| --- | --- |
| `R` | リポジトリ情報を更新 |
| `?` | ヘルプ表示切り替え |
| `q` / `Esc` | 終了 |

## 注意点と制限

- TUI は全ブランチから最大 500 件を表示します。
- マージコミットの差分は最初の親との比較、初期コミットは空ツリーとの差分です。
- 変更ファイル一覧は 50 件までで、バイナリファイルは対象外です。
- ステージ済みまたは未ステージの変更（未追跡ファイルは除く）がある場合、先頭に「uncommitted changes」行が表示されます。
- 同一コミットに複数ブランチがある場合、ラベルは1つに集約され `+N` 表記になります（例: `main +2`）。`h`/`l` または `←`/`→` で切り替え可能です。
- `origin/xxx` を checkout すると、ローカルブランチを作成または更新します。上流の設定は新規作成時のみ行われます。ローカルブランチが別コミットを指している場合は、リモートに合わせて強制的に更新されます。
- リモートブランチは表示されますが、削除操作はローカルブランチのみ対応です。
- fetch には `origin` リモートの設定が必要です。

# Configuration

keifu can be configured via `~/.config/keifu/config.toml`. All settings are optional.

## Auto-refresh

By default, keifu automatically refreshes the commit graph every 10 seconds and fetches from origin every 60 seconds.

```toml
[refresh]
# Enable auto-refresh for local state (default: true)
auto_refresh = true

# Interval in seconds for local refresh (default: 10, minimum: 1)
refresh_interval = 10

# Enable auto-fetch from origin (default: true)
auto_fetch = true

# Interval in seconds for remote fetch (default: 60, minimum: 10)
fetch_interval = 60
```

### Options

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `auto_refresh` | bool | `true` | Enable auto-refresh for local state (commits, branches, working tree) |
| `refresh_interval` | integer | `10` | Interval in seconds for local refresh (minimum: 1) |
| `auto_fetch` | bool | `true` | Enable auto-fetch from origin |
| `fetch_interval` | integer | `60` | Interval in seconds for remote fetch (minimum: 10) |

### Disabling auto-refresh

To disable automatic updates entirely:

```toml
[refresh]
auto_refresh = false
auto_fetch = false
```

You can still manually refresh with `R` and fetch with `f`.
# 設定

keifu は `~/.config/keifu/config.toml` で設定できます。すべての設定は任意です。

## 自動更新

デフォルトでは、keifu は 10 秒ごとにコミットグラフを更新し、60 秒ごとに origin から fetch します。

```toml
[refresh]
# ローカル状態の自動更新を有効にする（デフォルト: true）
auto_refresh = true

# ローカル更新の間隔（秒）（デフォルト: 10、最小: 1）
refresh_interval = 10

# origin からの自動 fetch を有効にする（デフォルト: true）
auto_fetch = true

# リモート fetch の間隔（秒）（デフォルト: 60、最小: 10）
fetch_interval = 60
```

### オプション一覧

| キー | 型 | デフォルト | 説明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `auto_refresh` | bool | `true` | ローカル状態（コミット、ブランチ、ワーキングツリー）の自動更新を有効にする |
| `refresh_interval` | integer | `10` | ローカル更新の間隔（秒）（最小: 1） |
| `auto_fetch` | bool | `true` | origin からの自動 fetch を有効にする |
| `fetch_interval` | integer | `60` | リモート fetch の間隔（秒）（最小: 10） |

### 自動更新を無効にする

自動更新を完全に無効にするには:

```toml
[refresh]
auto_refresh = false
auto_fetch = false
```

手動での更新は `R` キー、fetch は `f` キーで引き続き可能です。

const PALETTE: [Color; 9] = [
    Color::Green,
    Color::Magenta,
    Color::Yellow,
    Color::Red,
    Color::LightCyan,
    Color::LightGreen,
    Color::LightMagenta,

pub fn lane_color(idx: usize) -> Color {
    if idx == UNCOMMITTED_COLOR {
        Color::DarkGray
    } else if idx == 0 {
        Color::LightBlue
    } else {
        PALETTE[(idx - 1) % PALETTE.len()]
    }
}

const MIN_MESSAGE_WIDTH: usize = 50;
const MAX_LABEL_WIDTH: usize = 38;
const MAX_SEARCH_VISIBLE: usize = 7;

fn truncate_width(s: &str, max: usize) -> String {
    let mut w = 0;
    let mut out = String::new();
    for ch in s.chars() {
        let cw = ch.width().unwrap_or(0);
        if w + cw > max {
            break;
        }
        w += cw;
        out.push(ch);
    }
    out
}

fn pad_to(s: &str, width: usize) -> String {
    let t = truncate_width(s, width);
    let w = t.width();
    let mut out = t;
    for _ in w..width {
        out.push(' ');
    }
    out
}

fn format_date(ts: i64) -> String {
    match Local.timestamp_opt(ts, 0) {
        chrono::LocalResult::Single(dt) => dt.format("%Y-%m-%d").to_string(),
        chrono::LocalResult::Ambiguous(dt, _) => dt.format("%Y-%m-%d").to_string(),
        _ => String::new(),
    }
}

fn format_datetime(ts: i64) -> String {
    match Local.timestamp_opt(ts, 0) {
        chrono::LocalResult::Single(dt) => dt.format("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S").to_string(),
        chrono::LocalResult::Ambiguous(dt, _) => dt.format("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S").to_string(),
        _ => String::new(),
    }
}

fn truncate_branch_name(name: &str, max: usize) -> String {
    let chars: Vec<char> = name.chars().collect();
    if chars.len() <= max {
        return name.to_string();
    }
    let keep_end = 5usize;
    let keep_start = max.saturating_sub(3 + keep_end);
    let start: String = chars[..keep_start.min(chars.len())].iter().collect();
    let end: String = chars[chars.len().saturating_sub(keep_end)..].iter().collect();
    format!("{}...{}", start, end)
}

pub fn label_text(branches: &[BranchLabel], shown: usize) -> String {
    let b = &branches[shown.min(branches.len() - 1)];
    if branches.len() == 1 {
        if let Some(remote) = &b.twin_remote {
            if !b.is_remote {
                let suffix = format!(" ↔ {}", remote);
                let name = truncate_branch_name(&b.name, MAX_LABEL_WIDTH.saturating_sub(suffix.chars().count()));
                return format!("[{}{}]", name, suffix);
            }
        }
        let name = truncate_branch_name(&b.name, MAX_LABEL_WIDTH);
        return format!("[{}]", name);
    }
    let suffix = format!(" +{}", branches.len() - 1);
    let name = truncate_branch_name(&b.name, MAX_LABEL_WIDTH.saturating_sub(suffix.len()));
    format!("[{}]{}", name, suffix)
}

pub fn draw(f: &mut Frame, app: &mut App) {
    let area = f.area();
    let outer = Layout::vertical([Constraint::Min(0), Constraint::Length(1)]).split(area);
    let main = Layout::vertical([Constraint::Percentage(70), Constraint::Percentage(30)]).split(outer[0]);
    draw_commits(f, app, main[0]);
    let bottom = main[1];
    let parts = if bottom.width >= 57 {
        Layout::horizontal([Constraint::Percentage(50), Constraint::Percentage(50)]).split(bottom)
    } else {
        Layout::vertical([Constraint::Percentage(50), Constraint::Percentage(50)]).split(bottom)
    };
    draw_detail(f, app, parts[0]);
    draw_files(f, app, parts[1]);
    draw_status(f, app, outer[1]);

    match &app.mode {
        Mode::Normal => draw_branch_popup(f, app, main[0]),
        Mode::Help => draw_help(f, area),
        Mode::Input(s) => draw_input(f, area, s),
        Mode::Confirm(name) => draw_confirm(f, area, name),
        Mode::Search(st) => draw_search(f, area, st),
        Mode::Error(_) => {}
    }
}

fn graph_spans(cells: &[Cell], lanes: usize) -> Vec<Span<'static>> {
    let mut spans = Vec::new();
    for i in 0..(lanes * 2) {
        let c = cells.get(i).copied().unwrap_or(Cell::EMPTY);
        let mut st = Style::default().add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD);
        if let Some(col) = c.color {
            if !c.is_empty() {
                st = st.fg(lane_color(col));
            }
        }
        spans.push(Span::styled(c.ch.to_string(), st));
    }
    spans
}

fn draw_commits(f: &mut Frame, app: &mut App, area: Rect) {
    let block = Block::default()
        .borders(Borders::ALL)
        .title(" Commits ")
        .border_style(Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray));
    let inner = block.inner(area);
    app.commit_area_height = inner.height as usize;
    let width = inner.width as usize;
    let lanes = app.graph.width_lanes.max(1);
    let prefix = 1 + lanes * 2 + 1;
    let avail = width.saturating_sub(prefix);
    let (show_date, show_author, show_hash) = if avail >= 31 + MIN_MESSAGE_WIDTH {
        (true, true, true)
    } else if avail >= 22 + MIN_MESSAGE_WIDTH {
        (true, true, false)
    } else if avail >= 11 + MIN_MESSAGE_WIDTH {
        (false, true, false)
    } else {
        (false, false, false)
    };
    let right_w = if show_hash { 31 } else if show_date { 22 } else if show_author { 11 } else { 0 };
    let msg_w = avail.saturating_sub(right_w);
    let selected_branch_idx = app.selected_branch_index();

    let mut items: Vec<ListItem> = Vec::with_capacity(app.graph.rows.len());
    for (ri, row) in app.graph.rows.iter().enumerate() {
        let mut spans: Vec<Span> = vec![Span::raw(" ")];
        spans.extend(graph_spans(&row.cells, lanes));
        spans.push(Span::raw(" "));
        match &row.kind {
            RowKind::Uncommitted => {
                spans.push(Span::styled(
                    format!("uncommitted changes ({})", app.data.uncommitted_count),
                    Style::default().fg(Color::White),
                ));
            }
            RowKind::Connector => {}
            RowKind::Commit { index, color, .. } => {
                let c = &app.data.commits[*index];
                let mut used = 0usize;
                let branches = app.data.branches.get(&c.oid).map(|v| v.as_slice()).unwrap_or(&[]);
                if !branches.is_empty() {
                    let is_sel = ri == app.selected;
                    let shown = if is_sel { selected_branch_idx.unwrap_or(0) } else { 0 };
                    let text = label_text(branches, shown);
                    let fg = if is_sel && selected_branch_idx.is_some() {
                        Color::Black
                    } else {
                        lane_color(*color)
                    };
                    let lw = text.width();
                    let text = if lw > msg_w { truncate_width(&text, msg_w) } else { text };
                    used = text.width();
                    spans.push(Span::styled(text, Style::default().fg(fg).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD)));
                    if used < msg_w {
                        spans.push(Span::raw(" "));
                        used += 1;
                    }
                }
                let rest = msg_w.saturating_sub(used);
                spans.push(Span::raw(pad_to(&c.summary, rest)));
                if show_date {
                    spans.push(Span::raw(" "));
                    spans.push(Span::styled(format_date(c.time), Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray)));
                }
                if show_author {
                    spans.push(Span::raw("  "));
                    spans.push(Span::styled(pad_to(&c.author_name, 8), Style::default().fg(Color::Cyan)));
                }
                if show_hash {
                    spans.push(Span::raw("  "));
                    spans.push(Span::styled(c.short.clone(), Style::default().fg(Color::Yellow)));
                }
                if right_w > 0 {
                    spans.push(Span::raw(" "));
                }
            }
        }
        items.push(ListItem::new(Line::from(spans)));
    }
    let list = List::new(items)
        .block(block)
        .highlight_style(Style::default().bg(Color::DarkGray).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD));
    f.render_stateful_widget(list, area, &mut app.list_state);
}

fn draw_detail(f: &mut Frame, app: &App, area: Rect) {
    let block = Block::default()
        .borders(Borders::ALL)
        .title(" Commit Detail ")
        .border_style(Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray));
    let mut lines: Vec<Line> = Vec::new();
    let bold = Style::default().add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD);
    match app.graph.rows.get(app.selected).map(|r| &r.kind) {
        None => {
            lines.push(Line::from(Span::styled("Select a commit", Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray))));
        }
        Some(RowKind::Connector) => {
            lines.push(Line::from(Span::styled("(connector line)", Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray))));
        }
        Some(RowKind::Uncommitted) => {
            lines.push(Line::from(Span::styled(
                "Uncommitted Changes",
                Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD),
            )));
            lines.push(Line::from(""));
            lines.push(Line::from(format!("{} files with changes", app.data.uncommitted_count)));
        }
        Some(RowKind::Commit { index, .. }) => {
            let c = &app.data.commits[*index];
            lines.push(Line::from(vec![
                Span::styled("Commit: ", bold),
                Span::styled(c.oid.to_string(), Style::default().fg(Color::Yellow)),
            ]));
            lines.push(Line::from(vec![
                Span::styled("Author: ", bold),
                Span::styled(format!("{} <{}>", c.author_name, c.author_email), Style::default().fg(Color::Blue)),
            ]));
            lines.push(Line::from(vec![
                Span::styled("Date:   ", bold),
                Span::styled(format_datetime(c.time), Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray)),
            ]));
            if !c.parents.is_empty() {
                let ps: Vec<String> = c.parents.iter().map(|p| p.to_string()[..7].to_string()).collect();
                lines.push(Line::from(vec![
                    Span::styled("Parent: ", bold),
                    Span::styled(ps.join(", "), Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray)),
                ]));
            }
            lines.push(Line::from(""));
            for l in c.message.lines() {
                lines.push(Line::from(l.to_string()));
            }
        }
    }
    let p = Paragraph::new(lines).block(block).wrap(Wrap { trim: false });
    f.render_widget(p, area);
}

fn draw_files(f: &mut Frame, app: &App, area: Rect) {
    let block = Block::default()
        .borders(Borders::ALL)
        .title(" Changed Files ")
        .border_style(Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray));
    let mut lines: Vec<Line> = Vec::new();
    if !app.graph.rows.is_empty() {
        match &app.diff {
            None => {
                lines.push(Line::from("Loading..."));
            }
            Some(d) => {
                lines.push(Line::from(vec![
                    Span::styled(format!("{} files changed", d.total_files), Style::default().add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD)),
                    Span::raw("  "),
                    Span::styled(format!("+{}", d.additions), Style::default().fg(Color::Green)),
                    Span::raw(" "),
                    Span::styled(format!("-{}", d.deletions), Style::default().fg(Color::Red)),
                ]));
                lines.push(Line::from(""));
                for fc in &d.files {
                    let color = match fc.status {
                        'A' => Color::Green,
                        'D' => Color::Red,
                        'M' => Color::Yellow,
                        'R' => Color::Cyan,
                        _ => Color::White,
                    };
                    let mut spans = vec![
                        Span::styled(format!(" {} ", fc.status), Style::default().fg(color)),
                        Span::raw(fc.path.clone()),
                    ];
                    if !fc.binary {
                        spans.push(Span::raw(" "));
                        spans.push(Span::styled(format!("+{}", fc.additions), Style::default().fg(Color::Green)));
                        spans.push(Span::raw(" "));
                        spans.push(Span::styled(format!("-{}", fc.deletions), Style::default().fg(Color::Red)));
                    }
                    lines.push(Line::from(spans));
                }
                if d.total_files > d.files.len() {
                    lines.push(Line::from(""));
                    lines.push(Line::from(Span::styled(
                        format!("  ...and {} more files", d.total_files - d.files.len()),
                        Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray),
                    )));
                }
            }
        }
    }
    let p = Paragraph::new(lines).block(block);
    f.render_widget(p, area);
}

fn key_span(k: &str) -> Span<'static> {
    Span::styled(
        format!(" {} ", k),
        Style::default().fg(Color::Black).bg(Color::Cyan).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD),
    )
}

fn desc_span(d: &str) -> Span<'static> {
    Span::styled(d.to_string(), Style::default().fg(Color::White))
}

fn draw_status(f: &mut Frame, app: &App, area: Rect) {
    let mut spans: Vec<Span> = vec![
        Span::styled(
            format!(" {} ", app.repo_name),
            Style::default().fg(Color::Black).bg(Color::Magenta).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD),
        ),
        Span::raw(" "),
    ];
    match &app.data.head {
        HeadState::Branch(n) => {
            spans.push(Span::styled(format!(" {} ", n), Style::default().fg(Color::Black).bg(Color::Green)));
            spans.push(Span::raw(" "));
        }
        HeadState::Detached => {
            spans.push(Span::styled(" HEAD ", Style::default().fg(Color::Black).bg(Color::Green)));
            spans.push(Span::raw(" "));
        }
        HeadState::Unborn => {}
    }
    let indicator: Option<&str> = match &app.mode {
        Mode::Normal => None,
        Mode::Help => Some("HELP"),
        Mode::Input(_) | Mode::Search(_) => Some("INPUT"),
        Mode::Confirm(_) => Some("CONFIRM"),
        Mode::Error(_) => Some("ERROR"),
    };
    match &app.mode {
        Mode::Normal => {
            if let Some(msg) = app.visible_message() {
                let bg = if app.fetching { Color::Yellow } else { Color::Cyan };
                spans.push(Span::styled(
                    format!(" {} ", msg),
                    Style::default().fg(Color::Black).bg(bg).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD),
                ));
            } else {
                let hints = [
                    ("j/k", "move "),
                    ("Enter", "checkout "),
                    ("b", "branch "),
                    ("f", "fetch "),
                    ("?", "help "),
                    ("q", "quit"),
                ];
                for (k, d) in hints {
                    spans.push(key_span(k));
                    spans.push(desc_span(d));
                }
            }
        }
        Mode::Help => {
            spans.push(key_span("Esc/q"));
            spans.push(desc_span("close help"));
        }
        Mode::Input(_) | Mode::Search(_) => {
            spans.push(key_span("Enter"));
            spans.push(desc_span("confirm "));
            spans.push(key_span("Esc"));
            spans.push(desc_span("cancel"));
        }
        Mode::Confirm(_) => {
            spans.push(key_span("y"));
            spans.push(desc_span("yes "));
            spans.push(key_span("n"));
            spans.push(desc_span("no"));
        }
        Mode::Error(msg) => {
            spans.push(Span::styled(
                format!(" {} ", msg),
                Style::default().fg(Color::White).bg(Color::Red).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD),
            ));
            spans.push(Span::raw("  "));
            spans.push(key_span("Esc/Enter"));
            spans.push(desc_span("close"));
        }
    }
    if let Some(ind) = indicator {
        let text = format!(" {} ", ind);
        let w = text.width() as u16;
        let chunks = Layout::horizontal([Constraint::Min(0), Constraint::Length(w)]).split(area);
        f.render_widget(Paragraph::new(Line::from(spans)), chunks[0]);
        f.render_widget(
            Paragraph::new(Line::from(Span::styled(
                text,
                Style::default().fg(Color::Black).bg(Color::Yellow).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD),
            ))),
            chunks[1],
        );
    } else {
        f.render_widget(Paragraph::new(Line::from(spans)), area);
    }
}

pub fn centered_rect(percent_x: u16, percent_y: u16, r: Rect) -> Rect {
    let v = Layout::vertical([
        Constraint::Percentage((100 - percent_y) / 2),
        Constraint::Percentage(percent_y),
        Constraint::Percentage((100 - percent_y) / 2),
    ])
    .split(r);
    Layout::horizontal([
        Constraint::Percentage((100 - percent_x) / 2),
        Constraint::Percentage(percent_x),
        Constraint::Percentage((100 - percent_x) / 2),
    ])
    .split(v[1])[1]
}

fn draw_branch_popup(f: &mut Frame, app: &App, commits_area: Rect) {
    let branches = app.row_branches(app.selected);
    if branches.len() < 2 {
        return;
    }
    let offset = app.list_state.offset();
    if app.selected < offset {
        return;
    }
    let inner_top = commits_area.y + 1;
    let row_y = inner_top as usize + (app.selected - offset);
    let max_name = branches.iter().map(|b| b.name.len()).max().unwrap_or(0);
    let width = (max_name + 4 + 2).min(50) as u16;
    let height = (branches.len() + 2) as u16;
    let right = commits_area.x + commits_area.width; // exclusive
    let x = right.saturating_sub(2 + width).max(commits_area.x);
    let mut y = (row_y + 1) as u16;
    let bottom = commits_area.y + commits_area.height;
    if y + height > bottom {
        y = bottom.saturating_sub(height).max(commits_area.y);
    }
    let height = height.min(bottom.saturating_sub(y));
    let rect = Rect { x, y, width: width.min(commits_area.width), height };
    let sel = app.selected_branch_index();
    let inner_w = width.saturating_sub(2) as usize;
    let name_max = inner_w.saturating_sub(2);
    let mut lines = Vec::new();
    for (i, b) in branches.iter().enumerate() {
        let name = if b.name.len() > name_max {
            let mut s: String = String::new();
            for ch in b.name.chars() {
                if s.len() + ch.len_utf8() > name_max.saturating_sub(3) {
                    break;
                }
                s.push(ch);
            }
            format!("{}...", s)
        } else {
            b.name.clone()
        };
        if Some(i) == sel {
            lines.push(Line::from(Span::styled(
                format!("▶ {}", name),
                Style::default().fg(Color::Black).bg(Color::Blue).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD),
            )));
        } else {
            lines.push(Line::from(Span::styled(format!("  {}", name), Style::default().fg(Color::White))));
        }
    }
    let block = Block::default()
        .borders(Borders::ALL)
        .title(" Branches ")
        .border_style(Style::default().fg(Color::Blue))
        .style(Style::default().bg(Color::Black));
    f.render_widget(Clear, rect);
    f.render_widget(Paragraph::new(lines).block(block), rect);
}

fn draw_help(f: &mut Frame, area: Rect) {
    let rect = centered_rect(60, 70, area);
    let header = Style::default().fg(Color::Yellow).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD);
    let key = Style::default().fg(Color::Cyan).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD);
    let desc = Style::default().fg(Color::White);
    let sections: [(&str, &[(&str, &str)]); 4] = [
        (
            "Navigation",
            &[
                ("j / ↓", "Move down"),
                ("k / ↑", "Move up"),
                ("] / Tab", "Select next branch"),
                ("[ / S-Tab", "Select previous branch"),
                ("h / ←", "Select left branch (same commit)"),
                ("l / →", "Select right branch (same commit)"),
                ("Ctrl+d", "Page down"),
                ("Ctrl+u", "Page up"),
                ("g / Home", "Go to top"),
                ("G / End", "Go to bottom"),
                ("@", "Jump to HEAD (current branch)"),
            ],
        ),
        (
            "Git Operations",
            &[
                ("Enter", "Checkout selected branch/commit"),
                ("b", "Create new branch"),
                ("d", "Delete branch"),
                ("f", "Fetch from origin"),
            ],
        ),
        (
            "Search",
            &[
                ("/", "Search branches"),
                ("↑ / C-k", "Select previous result"),
                ("↓ / C-j", "Select next result"),
                ("Enter", "Jump to selected branch"),
                ("Esc", "Cancel search"),
            ],
        ),
        (
            "Other",
            &[("R", "Refresh"), ("?", "Toggle this help"), ("q / Esc", "Quit")],
        ),
    ];
    let mut lines: Vec<Line> = Vec::new();
    for (si, (title, items)) in sections.iter().enumerate() {
        if si > 0 {
            lines.push(Line::from(""));
        }
        lines.push(Line::from(Span::styled(title.to_string(), header)));
        for (k, d) in items.iter() {
            let kp = format!("  {}", k);
            let w = kp.width();
            let kp = if w < 13 { format!("{}{}", kp, " ".repeat(13 - w)) } else { kp };
            lines.push(Line::from(vec![Span::styled(kp, key), Span::styled(d.to_string(), desc)]));
        }
    }
    let block = Block::default()
        .borders(Borders::ALL)
        .title(" Help ")
        .border_style(Style::default().fg(Color::Cyan))
        .style(Style::default().bg(Color::Black));
    f.render_widget(Clear, rect);
    f.render_widget(Paragraph::new(lines).block(block), rect);
}

fn draw_input(f: &mut Frame, area: Rect, s: &str) {
    let rect = centered_rect(50, 20, area);

fn draw_confirm(f: &mut Frame, area: Rect, name: &str) {

fn draw_search(f: &mut Frame, area: Rect, st: &SearchState) {
    let width = area.width * 60 / 100;
    let x = area.x + (area.width - width) / 2;
    let inner_w = width.saturating_sub(2) as usize;
    let dim = Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray);
    let mut lines: Vec<Line> = Vec::new();
    lines.push(Line::from(vec![
        Span::raw("  "),
        Span::styled(st.query.clone(), Style::default().fg(Color::White).add_modifier(Modifier::UNDERLINED)),
        Span::styled("_", Style::default().fg(Color::Cyan)),
    ]));
    if !st.results.is_empty() {
        lines.push(Line::from(Span::styled("─".repeat(inner_w), dim)));
        let n = st.results.len();
        let visible = n.min(MAX_SEARCH_VISIBLE);
        let offset = st.offset;
        for vi in 0..visible {
            let i = offset + vi;
            let r = &st.results[i];
            let more_above = offset > 0;
            let more_below = offset + visible < n;
            let is_sel = i == st.selected;
            let marker = if is_sel {
                if vi == visible - 1 && more_below {
                    "▼ "
                } else if vi == 0 && more_above {
                    "▲ "
                } else {
                    "▶ "
                }
            } else if vi == 0 && more_above {
                "↑ "
            } else if vi == visible - 1 && more_below {
                "↓ "
            } else {
                "  "
            };
            let mut spans = Vec::new();
            if is_sel {
                spans.push(Span::styled(marker, Style::default().fg(Color::Cyan)));
                spans.push(Span::styled(
                    r.name.clone(),
                    Style::default().fg(Color::Black).bg(Color::Cyan).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD),
                ));
            } else {
                spans.push(Span::styled(marker, dim));
                let hl = Style::default().fg(Color::Yellow).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD);
                let normal = Style::default().fg(Color::White);
                let mut cur = String::new();
                let mut cur_hl = false;
                for (ci, ch) in r.name.chars().enumerate() {
                    let h = r.positions.contains(&ci);
                    if h != cur_hl && !cur.is_empty() {
                        spans.push(Span::styled(std::mem::take(&mut cur), if cur_hl { hl } else { normal }));
                    }
                    cur_hl = h;
                    cur.push(ch);
                }
                if !cur.is_empty() {
                    spans.push(Span::styled(cur, if cur_hl { hl } else { normal }));
                }
            }
            lines.push(Line::from(spans));
        }
        lines.push(Line::from(Span::styled("  ↑↓: select  Enter: jump  Esc: cancel", dim)));
    } else {
        lines.push(Line::from(Span::styled("  Enter: confirm  Esc: cancel", dim)));
    }
    let height = (lines.len() + 2) as u16;
    let bottom = area.y + area.height.saturating_sub(1);
    let y = bottom.saturating_sub(height);
    let rect = Rect { x, y, width, height: height.min(bottom - area.y) };
    let block = Block::default()
        .borders(Borders::ALL)
        .title(" Search branches ")
        .border_style(Style::default().fg(Color::Cyan))
        .style(Style::default().bg(Color::Black));
    f.render_widget(Clear, rect);
    f.render_widget(Paragraph::new(lines).block(block), rect);
}

seed = int(sys.argv[1]); path = sys.argv[2]; n_ops = int(sys.argv[3]) if len(sys.argv) > 3 else 40
tie = os.environ.get('TIE') == '1'
random.seed(seed)
subprocess.run(['rm', '-rf', path]); os.makedirs(path)
def git(*a, env=None):
    return subprocess.run(['git'] + list(a), cwd=path, capture_output=True, text=True, env=env)
git('init', '-q', '-b', 'main'); git('config', 'user.name', 'R'); git('config', 'user.email', 'r@x')
t = 1700000000
branches = ['main']
cnt = 0
def commit(br):
    global t, cnt
    cnt += 1
    if not tie: t += random.randint(1, 600)
    env = dict(os.environ, GIT_AUTHOR_DATE=f'@{t} +0000', GIT_COMMITTER_DATE=f'@{t} +0000')
    git('checkout', '-q', br)
    fn = os.path.join(path, f'f{random.randint(0, 5)}.txt')
    with open(fn, 'a') as f: f.write(f'{cnt}\n')
    git('add', '-A')
    git('commit', '-q', '-m', f'{br} c{cnt}', env=env)
commit('main')
for _ in range(n_ops):
    r = random.random()
    if r < 0.5:
        commit(random.choice(branches))
    elif r < 0.7 and len(branches) < 8:
        src = random.choice(branches)
        nb = f'b{len(branches)}'
        git('branch', nb, src); branches.append(nb)
    elif r < 0.9 and len(branches) > 1:
        a, b = random.sample(branches, 2)
        if not tie: t += random.randint(1, 600)
        env = dict(os.environ, GIT_AUTHOR_DATE=f'@{t} +0000', GIT_COMMITTER_DATE=f'@{t} +0000')
        git('checkout', '-q', a)
        res = git('merge', '-q', '--no-ff', '-m', f'merge {b} into {a}', b, env=env)
        if res.returncode != 0:
            git('merge', '--abort')
    elif len(branches) > 2:
        b = random.choice(branches[1:])
        git('checkout', '-q', 'main'); git('branch', '-D', b); branches.remove(b)
git('checkout', '-q', random.choice(branches))

fn render_lines<'a, C: LineComposer<'a>>(mut composer: C, area: Rect, buf: &mut Buffer) {
    let mut y = 0;
    while let Some(ref wrapped) = composer.next_line() {
        render_line(wrapped, area, buf, y);
        y += 1;
        if y >= area.height {
            break;
        }
    }
}

fn render_line(wrapped: &WrappedLine<'_, '_>, area: Rect, buf: &mut Buffer, y: u16) {
    let mut x = get_line_offset(wrapped.width, area.width, wrapped.alignment);
    for StyledGrapheme { symbol, style } in wrapped.graphemes {
        let width = symbol.cell_width();
        if width == 0 {
            continue;
        }
        // Make sure to overwrite any previous character with a space (rather than a zero-width)
        let symbol = if symbol.is_empty() { " " } else { symbol };
        let position = Position::new(area.left() + x, area.top() + y);
        buf[position].set_symbol(symbol).set_style(*style);
        x += width;
    }
}

const fn get_line_offset(line_width: u16, text_area_width: u16, alignment: Alignment) -> u16 {
    match alignment {
        Alignment::Center => (text_area_width / 2).saturating_sub(line_width / 2),
        Alignment::Right => text_area_width.saturating_sub(line_width),
        Alignment::Left => 0,
    }
}

    fn style(&self) -> Style {
        self.style
    }

        self.style(style)
    }
}

I've written a Rust reimplementation of `keifu` 0.2.3 in `/workspace`, and in my side-by-side tests it renders identically to the original. Everything is committed; `target/` and `executable` are in `.gitignore`.

**How I checked it:** a script ran the original and my build in two tmux sessions with the same terminal size, repo and keystrokes. It then compared every screen cell, text and colours. The last full regression run was 319 of these comparisons, and every one matched with zero differences. A further 20 random tests run after that also matched. They covered:
- hand-built and randomly generated repos, including ones where every commit has the same timestamp, remote branches, uncommitted changes, detached HEAD, merge conflicts, more than 500 commits, and Japanese/accented text;
- many terminal sizes, including resizing while running;
- navigation, help, search, branch create/delete, checkout (including conflict errors), fetch, refresh, and auto-refresh.

**Build:** `compile.sh` builds offline from the Rust packages already cached on this machine and copies the binary to `./executable`. A fresh clone built cleanly in about 2.5 minutes. If the cache is missing, it falls back to downloading from the internet, which I haven't tested.

Things that are approximate or not covered:
- **Search ranking is inferred.** The original's scoring method isn't visible from outside, so I fitted bonus and penalty values to about 30 recorded result orders. They reproduced the original on 87 more test queries, but unusual names or queries could still rank differently.
- **"Loading..." never appears.** The original fills the Changed Files panel in the background and shows "Loading..." briefly; mine computes it straight away. This only shows up if a screen is captured within a fraction of a second of moving the cursor.
- **Tabs in commit messages** reach the terminal in the original, which shifts the line. The library version available here strips them, so I added a workaround to send them through the same way. It matched in my tests but is fiddly.
- **One rare graph case isn't verified:** when the uncommitted-changes line has to join HEAD from the left.

The original seems to have some quirks, and I copied them on purpose:
- Pressing Enter after creating a branch checks out the bare commit, not the new branch.
- A branch label can show a different name from the one the Branches popup marks as selected.
- Only `origin/` duplicates of local branches are hidden; other remotes always show.
- Branch names are not trimmed, so a name with spaces gives an error.
